description: This PHP source file defines the class `EditDropDownWizard`, which manages the user interface and processing logic for editing dropdown lists within the SuiteCRM module 'Studio'. It handles actions like welcoming the user, navigating back to other parts of the wizard, processing dropdown edits and saves, and overriding the display method to customize the wizard presentation.

classes.name: EditDropDownWizard
classes.description: A wizard class for editing dropdown lists in SuiteCRM's Studio module, extending the base `StudioWizard`, providing user guidance, navigation, and processing capabilities for dropdown management.

methods.name: welcome
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating that user can rename the global dropdown list.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Handles navigation back to the Studio wizard or module selection screens, cleaning output buffers and redirecting via HTTP headers.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Intended to return options for dropdown editing; currently commented out.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes specific user options like editing or saving dropdowns, requiring necessary PHP files, and calling helper methods.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides parent display method to prevent default wizard UI from being shown.
